record.original_question: Can practical methods be devised for proving termination of standard conditional rewriting systems, despite the interdependence between normalization and termination in such systems?

evidence.quote: Devise practical methods for proving termination of conditional rewriting systems.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A conditional term rewriting system (CTRS) is a finite set of conditional rewrite rules of the form l → r ⇐ s₁ = t₁, …, sₙ = tₙ, where l, r, s_i, t_i are terms over a signature, l is not a variable, and the rewrite relation is defined by: t →_R t' iff there is a rule l → r ⇐ s₁ = t₁, …, sₙ = tₙ, a substitution σ, and a position p in t such that t|_p = lσ, t' = t[rσ]_p, and for each i, s_iσ and t_iσ rewrite to a common term using →_R (so-called "standard" or "join" CTRSs of type 3). 

Such a system is called terminating if →_R is well-founded. The intrinsic difficulty is that the definition of →_R itself depends on normalization (joinability of the conditions), which in turn depends on termination, making direct termination arguments delicate.

Problem: Develop practical, automatable methods for proving termination of standard conditional term rewriting systems, taking into account this circular interdependence between normalization and termination.
artifact.status_search_result: Substantial progress has been made: the notion of operational termination of CTRSs has been introduced and shown equivalent to quasi-decreasingness, and characterizations via context-sensitive quasi-reductivity and unraveling transformations exist for deterministic CTRSs. A 2D Dependency Pair Framework has been developed to automate termination proofs for CTRSs. However, fully practical and complete methods for arbitrary standard (join) CTRSs remain an active research area rather than fully closed.

status_evidence.title: Operational termination of conditional term rewriting systems
status_evidence.snippet: Operational termination of CTRSs is equivalent to quasi-decreasingness; existing methods apply.
status_evidence.claim: Provides a practical operational-termination framework for CTRSs.

status_evidence.title: Characterizing and proving operational termination of deterministic CTRSs
status_evidence.snippet: Operational termination of DCTRSs characterized via context-sensitive quasi-reductivity and unraveling.
status_evidence.claim: Gives practical methods via transformation to context-sensitive rewriting.

status_evidence.title: Simplifying conditional term rewriting systems
status_evidence.snippet: Simplifying systems extend termination and confluence results to the conditional framework.
status_evidence.claim: Early practical approach to CTRS termination.
